column6: Light through the clouds shines on the town.
Soon the rumbling from deep in the earth stopped.
The holy sword Moonlight Sword, which slew Gila,
was later delivered to the kingdom of Verdite.
Its light gone, the holy sword was sealed in the
Verdite royal vault for the third time.
The graves of the mercenary band in the labyrinth
Turning from the graves he had visited,
the young man set out back to town.
